images.description: Real official Snowflake slide/screenshot combo from the 'Getting Started with Snowflake Native Apps' quickstart, showing the Native App Framework concept alongside a real Snowsight Marketplace screenshot with real listed apps (SAP Data Merge, Capital One Software Slingshot, DTCC, etc.).

Real official Snowflake architecture diagram from the same quickstart, showing providers publishing code to the Snowflake Marketplace and a consumer installing and running that code against their own data.

Real Snowsight screenshot from the same quickstart, showing a Streamlit app ('Where Are My Ski Goggles?') running live inside an installed Snowflake Native App — exactly what a consumer sees after installing.

imageNote: All three images are real, unaltered material from Snowflake's own official Native Apps quickstart (Snowflake-Labs/sfquickstarts GitHub repo) — a provider/consumer architecture diagram, a Marketplace screenshot, and a running installed app.
